body.title: Activate persistent omnicoder daemons + 8-byte host agents (acer remote-control via file transfer)
body.objective: Run omnicoder permanently via falcon-omnicoder-persistent.sh (respawn watchdog, detached stdio) so it receives packets any time; activate the 8-byte host-process agents that process the fabric on Falcon.
body.truth_boundary: Operator-authorized activation request delivered by direct file transfer; held-safe pipeline.
